findings.message: ALTER COLUMN email TYPE rewrites public.users and rebuilds its indexes: text to character varying(100) adds or lowers a length limit, so every value is checked
findings.safeAlternative: Add a new column of the new type, write to both, backfill in batches, switch reads, then drop the old column

findings.message: public.users.email: text to character varying(100) adds or lowers a length limit, so every value is checked

findings.message: requests ACCESS EXCLUSIVE on public.users without a lock_timeout; while it waits, later queries on the table queue behind it
findings.safeAlternative: SET lock_timeout = '2s' before it (SET LOCAL inside the transaction) and retry the migration on timeout
